verdict.rationale: Skills for Real Engineers is a collection of SKILL.md instruction files that run inside coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor) and are installed via npx or plugin commands. It has no product UI and no service API, so UI-to-API parity is a category error for this kind of product. The non-interactive npx install path is an installer convenience, not API parity, and does not make the axis applicable.
